deliveredSummary: No explicit forward management promises were listed. Reported performance shows strong Q2 FY27 operational recovery, with revenue reaching Rs 394 crore and EBITDA margins returning to 58%, recovering from margin compression seen in late FY26.

divergences.story: Management highlighted rising technology costs and margin pressures during early 2026 calls.
divergences.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped to a low of 44% in Mar 2026 before recovering to 58% in Sep 2026.

bull: Revenue grew 23.5% YoY to Rs 394 crore in Sep 2026 quarter.
EBITDA margin recovered strongly to 58.0% in Sep 2026 from 44.0% in Mar 2026.
Debt to equity remained consistently at 0.00 with cumulative cash conversion at 97%.
bear: Annual EBITDA margin contracted from 66.0% in Mar 2022 to 51.0% in Mar 2026.
Net profit saw YoY declines across multiple quarters, including -20.0% in Mar 2026.
Cash from operations fell to Rs 467 crore in Mar 2026 from Rs 543 crore in Mar 2025.
business: CDSL is a Market Infrastructure Institution facilitating holding of securities in dematerialised form and enabling transactions for exchanges, clearing corporations, depository participants, issuers, and investors.
